results.title: Grace's Theory
results.overview: Grace, forty, is a scientist at the Exousia Foundation. When her boss Giovanni informs her of the death of her colleague Xiu Chen — his camp ransacked and burned, his computer missing — Grace travels to Costa Rica to recover the documents from his research into plants capable of tolerating high levels of CO₂.  On the island where Xiu conducted secret experiments, guided by his young assistant Santiago, Grace discovers a plant with extraordinarily long leaves, which had already appeared in her daughter’s dreams. After they are followed by a car, Grace flees to Italy with several specimens.  Back home, Xiu’s research attracts powerful interests. Between an old Biology professor, a multinational executive demanding the results, and an IT engineer hiding the data in a secure cloud, Grace discovers the true purpose of Xiu’s work: communicating with certain plant species and understanding their language. She decides to protect the research so it can remain a shared heritage of humanity.

results.title: The Ballad of the Dirty Water
results.overview: For years, agriculture has been blamed for the bad Danish aquatic environment. But farmers believe they don't bear the responsibility alone. For each year, large amounts of untreated wastewater are discharged into the same aquatic environment. But who's right? On opposite sides of a highly topical conflict, the farmers and scientists stand: Is agriculture the biggest culprit - or does the wastewater play a bigger role than previously thought?

results.title: Cocaine: A Colombian Powderkeg
results.overview: Cocaine is more widespread than ever before with more regular users and seizures at an all time high. In Colombia, production is booming, and after years of relative calm, extreme violence has come back to the streets with the drug traffickers. This documentary reveals the reality of today’s cocaine trade from production to export.

results.title: Family Guy Happy Hell-o-ween
results.overview: After unexpectedly dying and being sent to Hell, Stewie and Brian’s constant nagging leads The Devil to quit, passing control of Hell to them.

results.title: La priora
results.overview: In Cazalla de la Sierra, Carmen Ladrón de Guevara rescued an old Carthusian monastery in 1980 and transformed it into a unique cultural center and a meeting point for artists from across Europe. Decades later, after years of conflict, she no longer controls the Charterhouse she helped bring back to life. Today, she lives opposite it, gazing at it daily from her patio—caught between the memory of that dream and the traces that still remain.

results.title: Boiler Room No. 1
results.overview: Two young friends working on a steam ship, where nobody gets off, both aspire to be promoted to the coveted boiler room no. 1, which unbeknownst to them hides a dark secret.

results.title: Armeria
results.overview: Emil, who was less a boy and more a quiet, watchful mystery, is now a gentle ghost in the machine of memory. He communicates not with words, but through feelings, memories, and the strange, persistent animation of objects.

results.title: The World Facing Us: ICE, the Manhunt
results.overview: ICE: three letters long unfamiliar to the general public. Established in 2003 in response to the 9/11 attacks, this federal agency—part of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS)—is responsible for enforcing immigration and customs laws.

results.title: Glimpses Of Ideas
results.overview: What do we do once Hollywood has ended? Film is an expressive art form that has much more going for it than that. These glimpses of ideas and images show a different way of thinking to standard Hollywood.

results.title: Mike Hanford: LIVE IN TORONTO
results.overview: Mike Hanford films his debut stand-up special at the Comedy Bar on Bloor Street in Toronto.

results.title: The Anonymous Failure of the World
results.overview: A reflection about the conflict between dreams and reality. The director makes a visit to the island of Paquetá, where he has memories of childhood, friendship and love.

results.title: The Smiling One.
results.overview: A boy is left home alone. The lights go out. He searches for his parents in the dark. But he finds something else.

results.title: Punto de Rocío
results.overview: Inés and Marina, two friends, sneak into their swimming club and confront their suppressed desire. A decade later, the same patterns repeat themselves. Shifting between past and present, the story reveals how the depth of their feelings for one another are measured through their connection to water.

results.title: Not Like the Others
results.overview: Tired of dating apps, a woman embarks on one final date.

results.title: Por ahí
results.overview: Nacho, Benja’s best friend, is gone. In his place, there is only an obscure object. Benja waits for him, trying to decipher the clues he left behind. But even if Nacho does return, there is no certainty that he will be the same as before.

results.title: Contrapunto
results.overview: Luca is a teenager who loses his mother. On her deathbed, she gives him two letters: one for him and another for Ángel, his father, a renowned jazz musician whom Luca has never met. We follow Luca throughout the day as, motivated by his mother’s letter, he decides to deliver the letter to Ángel in an attempt to establish a bond with his father.
